description: This file defines a controller class 'Returns' within the Opencart admin panel, specifically handling sale returns management. It includes methods for listing, filtering, and viewing return data, and interacts with models related to return statuses.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale returns within the admin interface, providing listing, filtering, and detail viewing functionalities.

classes.description: Controller class for managing sale returns within the admin interface, providing listing, filtering, viewing, editing, adding, deleting, and history management functionalities.
